-- Step 1: Add read_year column to environmentalreadingscore
ALTER TABLE environmentalreadingscore ADD COLUMN read_year INTEGER;

-- Step 2: Populate read_year by extracting year from readtimestamp
UPDATE environmentalreadingscore SET read_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM readtimestamp)::INTEGER;

-- Step 3: Create the partitioned table
CREATE TABLE EnvironmentalReadingsCore_Partitioned (
    envreadregistry BIGINT,
    monitorcode CHARACTER VARYING,
    readtimestamp TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
    showcaseref CHARACTER VARYING,
    tempc SMALLINT,
    tempvar24h REAL,
    relhumidity SMALLINT,
    humvar24h REAL,
    airpresshpa NUMERIC,
    read_year INTEGER
) PARTITION BY RANGE (read_year);

-- Step 4: Create partitions for each year
CREATE TABLE EnvironmentalReadingsCore_2023 PARTITION OF EnvironmentalReadingsCore_Partitioned
    FOR VALUES FROM (2023) TO (2024);

CREATE TABLE EnvironmentalReadingsCore_2024 PARTITION OF EnvironmentalReadingsCore_Partitioned
    FOR VALUES FROM (2024) TO (2025);

CREATE TABLE EnvironmentalReadingsCore_2025 PARTITION OF EnvironmentalReadingsCore_Partitioned
    FOR VALUES FROM (2025) TO (2026);
